question.html:
The peak wavelength of radiation emitted by an object that can be considered a black body is nm. The object emits GJ of energy per second. Consider the following statements:

I. The emissivity of the object is one.

II. The temperature of the object is C. 

III. The surface area of the object is approximately m.

Which of these statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
